thread:
Lina Gomez: Quick note — Novus Health requested a 1-page SLA ops checklist + evidence bundle for their renewal. They want per-region uptime, per-route tails, and a step-by-step TCQ their SREs can run in under 10 minutes. Ticket CS-6101

Omar Patel: I’ll generate 7/30/90d rolling uptimes and per-route p95/p99 split (embed/generate/rerank) and include region column. Need tenant and whether to include commit window.

Lina Gomez: Tenant 660022. Yes include region (EU/US) and committed-capacity change history. Also they asked for a sample credit calc for the EU region. :memo: 

Eve Tran: Onboarding note: they enabled prefix cache + prefetcher on week 3. I’ll export the flag diff and timeline and add a short snippet to validate prefetch vs real KV hits.

Sam Ortiz: Novus is moderate renewal risk — price sensitivity and proration questions. Pack should have a plain-English credit example and a one-line exec summary procurement can forward.

billing-bot: Billing note — last committed capacity change: 2025-02-08. Billing contact: acct-billing@novushealth.com. Also include billing cycle start for proration.

Omar Patel: Export link: https://storage.redwood.ai/exports/CS-6101/660022_metrics_90d.zip (expires 7d). Files: uptime_by_day.csv, p99_by_route_region.csv, token_distribution.csv. Columns: ts,route,latency_ms,p99,p95,tokens,node_id,region,model_variant,status

Eve Tran: Quick TCQ snippets: kubectl log filter:
```
kubectl logs -l app=runtime -c inference --since=24h | grep "tenant=660022" | jq -r '.route + " " + (.latency_ms|tostring)'
```
curl cache check:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/embed -d '{"tenant":"660022","input":"cache-check"}' | grep X-Cache
```
promql to compare prefetch vs user hits:
```
rate(redwood_kv_prefetch_hits_total{tenant="660022"}[5m])
rate(redwood_kv_hits_total{tenant="660022"}[5m])
```

Omar Patel: Observations for pack: account 90d uptime = 99.907% overall; EU generate p99 = 270ms (tail due to ~28% requests >2k tokens). Embeds EU p99 = 165ms. Will call out token distribution and maintenance exclusions (2025-03-12 EU patch window).

Sam Ortiz: Credit example copy/paste (EU): "SLO: 99.9% monthly uptime (EU). Observed: 99.6%. Hours=720. Downtime=(1-0.996)*720=2.88h. Credit = prorated % of monthly region fee up to cap, after exclusions. Applied after validation (1-2 billing cycles)." Keep for procurement.

Lina Gomez: TCQ brief should include: dashboard view links, exact queries above, steps to reproduce a cache miss/hit, model_variant + quant profile. Make it a single page.

Eve Tran: Model note: embeds served from small-embed-v4 (q4_1_perf) in EU. Quant adds ~10ms baseline. Prefetcher increases apparent hits; use prefetch metric to filter.

Omar Patel: I’ll add a tiny worked table example showing sample numbers and the computed credit percent for clarity.

Lina Gomez: Action items summary: Omar attach exports + summary (done), Eve attach onboarding flags + TCQ snippets (in progress), Sam add exec line + FAQ (done), Lina assemble 2-pg pack and upload to CS-6101 by Tue EOD. I’ll ping when uploaded.

billing-bot: Ticket CS-6101 updated: evidence_tcq_v1.pdf uploaded by lina.gomez at 2815002234. Link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/cs/CS-6101/evidence_tcq_v1.pdf

Lina Gomez: Uploaded final pack. Please quick-review; will send to Novus after legal ok. Closing when Novus acknowledges.
